text: Which transport does post-anki use to send a todo to the Me agent?
default: HTTP POST with a JSON body to a URL set in ME_AGENT_TODO_URL. When the URL is unset, the feature reports 'not configured'.
reason: The Me agent exposes no network write interface and is out of scope, so post-anki has to stay agnostic to the endpoint.

text: How does post-anki authenticate to the Me agent?
default: A bearer token read from ME_AGENT_TODO_TOKEN, sent only when it is set.
reason: This is the simplest scheme that a networked MCP gateway or an HTTP endpoint could accept.

text: What does the todo payload contain?
default: The title plus the card's front text and a link to the card. Answers and review history are not sent.
reason: This is the minimum context the todo needs while limiting the user content that leaves post-anki.

reason: Review is the main surface. iPhone, extension and chat can follow once the transport exists.
